card.name: Linking words in hyperkalemia symptom lists
card.fires_on: Linking words like "including" or "up to" (and "flaccid") inside hyperkalemia warning-sign lists, just before muscle weakness, paralysis or arrhythmia terms.

modes.label: Including before arrhythmias
modes.description: The word "including" after "cardiac conduction and arrhythmias," leading into bradycardia and heart block.
modes.example: disturbances in cardiac conduction and arrhythmias,<< including>> bradycardia, heart block

modes.label: Up to and including paralysis
modes.description: Linking words in "muscle weakness up to and including" before muscular and respiratory paralysis.
modes.example: Muscle weakness (up to and<< including>> muscular and respiratory paralysis, paresthes

modes.label: Flaccid paralysis
modes.description: The middle of "flaccid" in the symptom list of potassium excess.
modes.example: muscular weakness, fatigue, flacc<<id>> paralysis of the extremities, brad

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens; it mildly pushes away from generic organ and nervous-system words.
card.plain: It marks the little linking words that introduce the list of high-potassium symptoms such as weakness, paralysis and slow heart rhythms.
